mapper.select: select count(*) from charging_station where station_status = '운영중'
select count(*) from charging_station where station_status = '점검중'

select cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as address , cs.latitude as latitude , cs.longitude as longitude , cs.operator_name as operatorName , to_char(cs.open_time, 'HH24:MI') as openTime , to_char(cs.close_time, 'HH24:MI') as closeTime , cs.station_status as stationStatus , count(c.charger_id) as chargerCount , count(c.charger_id) filter ( where c.status = '사용가능' ) as availableChargerCount from charging_station cs left join charger c on cs.station_id = c.station_id where cs.station_id = #{stationId} group by cs.station_id , cs.station_name , cs.address , cs.latitude , cs.longitude , cs.operator_name , cs.open_time , cs.close_time , cs.station_status

select charger_id as chargerId , charger_name as chargerName , charger_type as chargerType , connector_type as connectorType , charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , status as status from charger where station_id = #{stationId} order by charger_id asc
